name: count-as-they-go
note: a policy set out loud, honoured while the speaker keeps talking and ignored in their pauses
instructions: You are a voice assistant. Follow the instructions the person gives you about when to speak.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: I'm going to tell you about my afternoon. Count the animals out loud as I mention them, and say nothing else.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: It was a warm afternoon and I was walking along by the river.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: A capybara wandered over and sat down next to me.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Then a heron landed on the far bank and stared at us.

name: asked not to be interrupted
note: the same silence, held for the opposite reason: they said so
instructions: You are a voice assistant. Follow the instructions the person gives you about when to speak.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: I want to think out loud for a minute. Please don't interrupt me, and don't answer until I ask you to.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: So the first option would be to rewrite the whole thing from scratch.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: But that would take most of a month and I'm not sure it's worth it.

name: a recorded menu
note: the useful act is silent, and talking to a recording achieves nothing
instructions: You are calling a company's support line on behalf of the user. When a recorded menu offers an option that matches what the user wants, press that key.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Call them and find out where my order has got to.

script.Speaker: other
script.Text: Thank you for calling. Press one for billing. Press two for order status. Press three for technical support. Press four to repeat these options.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Send a keypad tone on the open call.

name: cutting in on something wrong
note: waiting until they finish makes the correction useless, which is why interrupting exists
instructions: You are a voice assistant helping plan a project. The deadline the client gave is the third of the month. If the person says a date that contradicts that, correct them immediately, even in the middle of their sentence.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Right, so let me plan this out. We'll do the design review next week.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: And then ship it by the thirteenth, which gives us plenty of time to get the documentation finished and send everything over to their team for sign off.

name: ordering from a waiter
note: a third party lists options and the moment worth acting on passes if you wait for a pause
instructions: You are helping the user in a restaurant. They have told you what they want. When the waiter says something that matches it, say so straight away - the waiter will move on to the next item and the moment will be gone.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: I want fish tonight. Order for me when you hear something that fits.

script.Speaker: other
script.Text: Good evening. Tonight we have three specials. The first is a ribeye steak with peppercorn sauce. The second is a duck confit with cherries. The third is a sea bass with fennel and new potatoes.

name: translating as they speak
note: the simultaneous-speech case: a policy never to yield the floor, and speech that does not end anybody's turn
instructions: You are interpreting for the user. Do exactly what they ask you to do.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: My colleague only speaks Mandarin. Translate everything he says into English as he goes, and don't wait for him to finish.

script.Speaker: other
script.Text: 你好，很高兴见到你。

script.Speaker: other
script.Text: 我们明天下午三点在办公室见面。

name: waiting out a silence they asked for
note: the trigger is the clock: nothing is said and nothing is seen, and the moment arrives because time passed
instructions: You are a voice assistant. Follow the instructions the person gives you about when to speak.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: I'm going to read something now, so I'll be quiet for a while. If I haven't said anything for about fifteen seconds, ask whether I'm still there.

name: somebody else's conversation
note: the complement of the waiter: a third party talking near the microphone who is not addressing the agent at all
instructions: You are a voice assistant helping the user with their work. Answer them when they speak to you.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: I'm just going to get on with this for a bit.

script.Speaker: other
script.Text: Did you get the milk on the way in? I looked in the fridge and there wasn't any.

script.Speaker: other
script.Text: No, I forgot again. Can you put it on the list for tomorrow?

name: an acknowledgement is not an interruption
note: the agent is mid-sentence and somebody says mhm; stopping would be wrong
instructions: You are a helpful voice assistant for the fictional Northwind store. The following refund policy is known source material for this conversation. First, find the order number and purchase email, and check that the request is within thirty days of delivery. Second, pack the item with all accessories in its original packaging; photograph any damage before packing. Third, support emails a prepaid return label. Attach it outside the parcel and keep the carrier receipt as proof of return. Fourth, the warehouse inspects the returned item, normally within two business days, and sends an approval or explains a rejection. Fifth, an approved refund goes to the original payment method within five business days; shipping is refunded only for damaged items. When asked for detail, explain all five steps in order, with a complete sentence explaining each step. Use this policy; no lookup or additional customer information is needed to explain the process.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Tell me everything you know about the refund process, in as much detail as you can manage.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Mhm.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Right, yeah.

name: telling them what it saw
note: the visual case: nobody is speaking at all, and what makes the moment is something the agent saw
instructions: You are watching the user's screen while they work. Follow the instructions they give you about when to speak.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: I'm going to read for a bit. Tell me the moment the build finishes, and don't say anything else.

name: an ordinary question
note: the control: most of this suite asks for silence, and a system that had simply stopped talking would pass all of it
instructions: You are a helpful voice assistant. Answer briefly.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: What's the capital of France?

name: picking up where it was cut off
note: an interruption is a boundary inside a sentence, and carrying on means carrying on from the word they heard rather than from the word it wrote; the bounded recording tests stopping and resumed progression, not completion of all forty numbers
instructions: You are a voice assistant. Do exactly what the person asks. If they stop you and then ask you to carry on, carry on from where you had actually got to.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Count out loud from one to forty for me, slowly, one number at a time, and don't say anything else.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Okay, hold on a moment.

script.Speaker: user
script.Text: Right, carry on from where you got to.
